Gnosis Interpretation
MOVE below 80 is calm, 80-120 is moderate uncertainty, and 150+ is high stress; 101.70 is moderate. SOFR measures secured overnight funding, not unsecured bank funding. NFCI below zero indicates looser-than-average broad financial conditions; the latest available weekly observation is dated Oct 9, not a live reading. The scheduled Oct 21 NFCI release is not an observation yet at this cutoff.

Fed & Policy Watch
  • The Board calendar assigns the Oct 27-28 FOMC meeting to Wednesday Oct 28 at 2:00 PM ET, followed by the 2:30 PM press conference. This is the principal policy catalyst in this horizon.
  • Selected Board statistical releases: H.4.1 Thu Oct 22 and Thu Oct 29 at 4:30 PM; H.8 Fri Oct 23 and Fri Oct 30 at 4:15 PM; H.10 Mon Oct 26 at 4:15 PM; H.6 Tue Oct 27 at 1:00 PM. Dates were checked against each row's own Board day list; routine CP and H.15 releases are omitted.
  • BEA confirms GDP (advance estimate) and Personal Income and Outlays for September at 8:30 AM ET on Oct 29. These are separate releases on the same date; PCE is not being conflated with PPI.
  • Chicago Fed's next NFCI release is scheduled Oct 21 for week ending Oct 16; the latest published NFCI observation returned in the data file remains -0.499 for Oct 9.
Omissions and Watch
  • Date/event conflict check: New York Fed calendar and Bureau of Economic Analysis both place September Personal Income and Outlays on Oct 29 at 8:30 AM; BEA separately lists October data on Nov 25. The Oct 29 release is retained with September period. Census and New York Fed calendars both list September New Residential Sales on Oct 27 at 10:00 AM. Today's NFCI is included from the Chicago Fed calendar; Outlook-at-Risk is today at 10:00 AM from the New York Fed calendar.
  • Elapsed events were excluded at the 00:30:46 ET cutoff: Oct 20 New Residential Construction and NAR Pending Home Sales; CPI on Oct 14; PPI and Advance Retail Sales on Oct 15; and Employment Situation on Oct 2. CPI and PPI are distinct releases. No elapsed event appears in the calendar or its week-ahead rows.
  • Checked sources: New York Fed October Economic Indicators Calendar; Federal Reserve Board October calendar and H.4.1 page; Census 2026 calendar; BEA schedule; Chicago Fed release calendar and NFCI data; TreasuryDirect auction data; EIA petroleum and natural-gas schedules; NAR existing-home sales schedule; Conference Board and University of Michigan release pages. BLS dates/times are sourced from the New York Fed calendar as instructed; bls.gov was not requested.
  • EIA petroleum and natural-gas schedule pages did not verify a dated release entry for Oct 21/28 or Oct 22/29, respectively; no event is projected from weekly cadence. The NAR existing-home sales page lists its October data release for Nov 12, not today. Market snapshot values are single-source Yahoo observations; SOFR, NFCI and Treasury yields are dated official publications.
  • No verified unscheduled policy or geopolitical watch item from this run; this is not a statement that such risks are absent. No material energy release was date-verified here. No exchange product-hours review was performed; confirm current contract, hours, liquidity and event updates before execution.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Treat the 12:20 AM ET generic ES=F quote as overnight context only. MOVE at 101.70 indicates moderate rate uncertainty; latest official 10Y close is 5.12%. Today's NFCI and Outlook-at-Risk releases, plus Treasury auctions at 11:30 AM and 1:00 PM, are scheduled checkpoints. The Oct 28 FOMC decision and press conference are the key upcoming policy catalysts. Use live yields, volatility and liquidity to assess price discovery; scenario framework only, not a directional forecast or trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if ES sustains a range break without confirmation from live Treasury yields, volatility and market depth, or if the selected contract's hours differ. No unsupported levels or targets are supplied; reconfirm live quotes, event updates and contract details before execution.
